변경 이유: 진단에 따라 `_synthetic_tracks`가 미등록 라이다 점에 실제 속도를 붙이도록 바꿨습니다. 새 스캔마다 점을 0.25 m 셀로 줄이고 `st["um_prev"]`에 쌓은 뒤, 약 0.15–0.45 s 전 프레임과 최근접 점을 짝지어 변위를 구합니다. 변위가 0.02 m 미만이거나 회전 잡음 한계 이하인 점은 속도 0으로 두고, 나머지는 0.5 m 이웃의 평균으로 속도를 다듬어 `(x, y, vx, vy, 0, 0)` 행을 만듭니다(지시 1–5). 반경 1.5 m가 늦다는 증거에 대응해 움직이는 점은 2.5 m부터 VO에 넣고, 정지한 미등록 점은 그대로 1.5 m 안에서만 넣습니다. 이렇게 해 멀리 있는 정지 잡음 때문에 생기는 불필요한 우회를 늘리지 않았습니다(지시 6, 가정 3).

```python
_SYN_MAX = 32


_SYN_MOVE_RANGE = 2.5


_SYN_MIN_DISP = 0.02


_SYN_MIN_SPEED = 0.15


_SYN_DT = (0.15, 0.45)


_SYN_NBR = 0.5


_SYN_CELLS_MAX = 200


def _synthetic_tracks(st, pose, M=None):
    """Velocity-aware synthetic tracks from unmapped raw lidar points (_unmapped_raw: walls, MISSION boxes and
    FIXED_OBSTACLES removed).  On every new lidar frame (st["raw"] changed) the points within _SYN_MOVE_RANGE of the
    body (own body within _PX_SELF dropped) are reduced to one nearest point per _SYN_CELL cell holding
    >= _SYN_MIN_PTS points, converted to world and stored in st["um_prev"] (last 0.6 s).  Each point is matched to
    its nearest point in the stored frame closest to 0.25 s old (age within _SYN_DT): displacement below
    max(_SYN_MIN_DISP, _SYN_MIN_SPEED * dt) + rotation noise, or above the 2 m/s bound, -> zero velocity; otherwise
    velocity = displacement / dt, averaged over the moving points within _SYN_NBR (at least 2 needed) and capped at
    _MAX_OBJECT_SPEED.  Rows (x, y, vx, vy, 0, 0): moving points up to _SYN_MOVE_RANGE, stationary points only
    within _SYN_RANGE; points within _RT_TRACK_R of a confirmed track are skipped; nearest first, at most _SYN_MAX."""
    empty = np.zeros((0, 6))
    hist = st.setdefault("um_prev", [])
    U = _unmapped_raw(st, pose)
    P = st["raw"]
    x, y, yaw = pose
    c, s = math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw)

    if st.get("syn_src") is not P:
        tf = float(st["p_t"])
        W = np.zeros((0, 2))
        if len(U):
            bx = np.maximum(np.maximum(_BODY[0] - U[:, 0], U[:, 0] - _BODY[1]), 0.0)
            by = np.maximum(np.maximum(_BODY[2] - U[:, 1], U[:, 1] - _BODY[3]), 0.0)
            da = np.hypot(bx, by)
            k = (da > _PX_SELF) & (da < _SYN_MOVE_RANGE)
            if k.any():
                Wa = to_world(U[k], pose)[:, :2]
                da = da[k]
                key = np.floor(Wa / _SYN_CELL).astype(np.int64)
                kid = (key[:, 0] + 2000) * 5000 + (key[:, 1] + 2000)
                order = np.argsort(da, kind="stable")
                _, first, cnt = np.unique(kid[order], return_index=True, return_counts=True)
                keep = cnt >= _SYN_MIN_PTS
                if keep.any():
                    idx = order[first[keep]]
                    idx = idx[np.argsort(da[idx], kind="stable")][:_SYN_CELLS_MAX]
                    W = Wa[idx]
        V = np.zeros_like(W)
        ref = None
        for th, Wh in hist:
            dt = tf - th
            if _SYN_DT[0] <= dt <= _SYN_DT[1] and len(Wh):
                if ref is None or abs(dt - 0.25) < abs(tf - ref[0] - 0.25):
                    ref = (th, Wh)
        if ref is not None and len(W):
            dt = tf - ref[0]
            Wh = ref[1]
            D = np.hypot(W[:, 0:1] - Wh[None, :, 0], W[:, 1:2] - Wh[None, :, 1])
            j = np.argmin(D, axis=1)
            disp = D[np.arange(len(W)), j]
            r = np.hypot(W[:, 0] - x, W[:, 1] - y)
            thr = max(_SYN_MIN_DISP, _SYN_MIN_SPEED * dt) + 0.1 * r * abs(st["wz"])
            mov = (disp >= thr) & (disp <= _MAX_OBJECT_SPEED * dt + 0.15)
            if mov.any():
                Vr = (W - Wh[j]) / dt
                Nb = np.hypot(W[:, 0:1] - W[None, mov, 0], W[:, 1:2] - W[None, mov, 1]) < _SYN_NBR
                nm = Nb.sum(axis=1)
                sv = Nb.astype(np.float64) @ Vr[mov]
                ok = mov & (nm >= 2)
                if ok.any():
                    V[ok] = sv[ok] / nm[ok][:, None]
                    sp = np.hypot(V[:, 0], V[:, 1])
                    big = sp > _MAX_OBJECT_SPEED
                    if big.any():
                        V[big] *= (_MAX_OBJECT_SPEED / sp[big])[:, None]
        hist.append((tf, W.copy()))
        st["um_prev"] = [h for h in hist if tf - h[0] <= 0.6][-8:]
        st["syn_src"] = P
        st["syn_W"] = W
        st["syn_V"] = V

    W = st.get("syn_W")
    V = st.get("syn_V")
    if W is None or len(W) == 0:
        return empty
    dxw, dyw = W[:, 0] - x, W[:, 1] - y
    qx = c * dxw + s * dyw
    qy = -s * dxw + c * dyw
    bx = np.maximum(np.maximum(_BODY[0] - qx, qx - _BODY[1]), 0.0)
    by = np.maximum(np.maximum(_BODY[2] - qy, qy - _BODY[3]), 0.0)
    bd = np.hypot(bx, by)
    moving = np.hypot(V[:, 0], V[:, 1]) > 1e-6
    k = (bd > _PX_SELF) & ((bd < _SYN_RANGE) | (moving & (bd < _SYN_MOVE_RANGE)))
    if not k.any():
        return empty
    Wk, Vk, dk = W[k], V[k], bd[k]
    if M is not None and len(M):
        mx = M[:, 0] + M[:, 2] * M[:, 4]
        my = M[:, 1] + M[:, 3] * M[:, 4]
        near = (np.hypot(Wk[:, 0:1] - mx[None, :], Wk[:, 1:2] - my[None, :]) < _RT_TRACK_R).any(axis=1)
        Wk, Vk, dk = Wk[~near], Vk[~near], dk[~near]
        if len(Wk) == 0:
            return empty
    o = np.argsort(dk, kind="stable")[:_SYN_MAX]
    rows = np.zeros((len(o), 6), dtype=np.float64)
    rows[:, 0] = Wk[o, 0]
    rows[:, 1] = Wk[o, 1]
    rows[:, 2] = Vk[o, 0]
    rows[:, 3] = Vk[o, 1]
    return rows
```
